meta.method: walk-forward backtest on the completed season; the model only ever saw gameweeks before the one it predicted
meta.minutes_path: minutes_model (production path, n_last=6, per-player gameweeks). Does not include the builder's live layers: apply_availability (FPL availability flag) and club/position depth adjustment, neither of which exists historically. The gate therefore measures the minutes model, not the whole builder.

known_bias.note: negative = the model under-predicts points on average; ranking is unaffected, absolute values run low
